def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    cars = image_patch.find("white car")
    roundabout_patches = image_patch.find("roundabout")
    left_street_patches = image_patch.find("street left")

    if not cars or not roundabout_patches or not left_street_patches:
        return []

    # Find cars near the roundabout
    near_roundabout_cars = [car for car in cars if distance(car, roundabout_patches[0]) < 10]

    # Find cars along the left side of the street
    left_street_cars = [car for car in cars if car.left < left_street_patches[0].horizontal_center]

    # Combine results
    result_cars = near_roundabout_cars + left_street_cars

    return result_cars
